title: The Roots of Health
subtitle: Sami & Mina are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 🦷🔬

Sami is a hurried dentist: 'Red gums? A little tartar? A scaling and it's fixed!' Mina, an expert in periodontology, corrects him: 'Not so fast, Sami! Periodontology is much more than just scaling.'

Between a 6 mm pocket, a Class III recession, a Grade 2 furcation, or aggressive periodontitis, periodontal health is a true art.

An incomplete diagnosis, an insufficient treatment, and the tooth is lost. A rigorous approach, regular maintenance, and the patient keeps their teeth for life.

The stability of teeth, patients' oral health, the preservation of smiles rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Sami is in a hurry: 'Red gums? A scaling and it's fixed!' Mina corrects him: 'Not so fast!' Discover the basics of periodontology: gingivitis, periodontitis, probing, risk factors.
chapters.debutant2: Sami and Mina delve into periodontal pathologies: deep pockets, furcations, recessions, aggressive periodontitis. They discover that each case is unique.
chapters.intermediaire1: Sami and Mina master periodontal diagnosis: complete assessment, classification, risk factors. They learn to precisely evaluate each patient.
chapters.intermediaire2: Sami and Mina tackle advanced therapies: surgeries, regeneration, furcations, recessions, maintenance. Periodontology is put to the test.
chapters.expert1: Sami and Mina become references in periodontology. They train young dentists on the importance of diagnosis and maintenance.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice, Sami and Mina leave a legacy of periodontal skills. Periodontology is the art of preserving the roots of health.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Sami understood that periodontology is more complex than a simple scaling. Mina is proud of him.
chapterEndings.debutant2: Sami and Mina master periodontal pathologies. They are ready for more complex cases.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Mastery of periodontal diagnosis is acquired. Sami and Mina are experts.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Advanced therapies are mastered. Sami and Mina take on all challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Periodontal strategy has become a philosophy. Sami and Mina train the next generation.
chapterEndings.expert2: Sami and Mina have accomplished their mission. Periodontology is the art of preserving the roots of health.
